result.description: A fictional 34-inch ultrawide curved desktop monitor designed for creative work and general productivity. It features a 3440x1440 VA panel, 100Hz refresh rate, USB-C input with 65W power delivery, HDMI and DisplayPort connectivity, and an integrated low-blue-light mode for comfortable long sessions. The matte black chassis includes a height-adjustable stand and a built-in cable management channel.
result.title: LumaGrid Aurora 34 Curved Monitor
